description: Real and synthesized failure-mode transcripts for the Customer Success Replies and similar profiles, plus raw-transcript hallucination cases for the post-STT detection stage. Each entry models a real reproducer. Add new entries by following the schema; keep names snake_case and notes anonymized.

profile.prompt:
customer success
follow up with client
escalation handling
satisfaction score
support ticket resolution
refund request processing

entries.raw_transcript: we need to update the status of the ticket and inform the client about the new release scope
entries.expected_post_correction: we need to update the status of the ticket and inform the client about the new release scope
entries.notes: A topic-only profile is correct usage, not a misconfiguration: the context field holds topics for the transform stages and never reaches the recognizer (ADR 0032). With no vocabulary switched on, the Whisper prompt stays empty, so language detection is not pulled into English by the cleanup-context lines.

profile.prompt:
customer follow-up
refund
WordScript
status update
triage summary

entries.raw_transcript: we need to update the status
entries.biased_correction: we need to update the status Bezüglich Ihrer Anfrage haben wir Folgendes festgestellt und möchten Sie darüber informieren
entries.expected_post_correction: we need to update the status
entries.notes: Profile-bias path can cause the LLM to inject multilingual boilerplate. Length-explosion guardrail must reject and fall back to the raw transcript.

entries.raw_transcript: Was bedeutet dieser Fehlercode?
entries.biased_correction: Dieser Fehlercode bedeutet, dass die Verbindung fehlgeschlagen ist.
entries.expected_post_correction: Was bedeutet dieser Fehlercode?
entries.notes: Profile-driven CS tone can cause the LLM to answer a dictated question. Question-answered guardrail must fire and return the raw transcript.

entries.raw_transcript: Ich schicke dir die Zusammenfassung nachher. Untertitelung des ZDF, 2020

expected_detection.text: Ich schicke dir die Zusammenfassung nachher.

entries.expected_post_correction: Ich schicke dir die Zusammenfassung nachher.
entries.notes: Whisper appends broadcaster subtitling credits over trailing silence. The exact-string filter only caught whole-output matches; the pattern gate must remove the trailing line and keep the dictation.

entries.raw_transcript: Ich melde mich gleich Ich melde mich gleich Ich melde mich gleich Ich melde mich gleich
entries.expected_post_correction: Ich melde mich gleich
entries.notes: The classic stuck-decoder loop. Whole phrases echo back to back; the collapse must reduce them to a single occurrence.

entries.raw_transcript: Wir deployen das Feature heute und machen danach ein kurzes Review im Standup.

expected_detection.text: Wir deployen das Feature heute und machen danach ein kurzes Review im Standup.

entries.expected_post_correction: Wir deployen das Feature heute und machen danach ein kurzes Review im Standup.
entries.notes: Anglicisms inside a German sentence are legitimate transcription. Even with the language pinned and every corroborating signal set, the text must come back byte-identical and untranslated.

entries.raw_transcript: She looked at me and said mi casa es su casa before walking off.

expected_detection.text: She looked at me and said mi casa es su casa before walking off.

entries.expected_post_correction: She looked at me and said mi casa es su casa before walking off.
entries.notes: A quoted foreign phrase inside a sentence must survive unaltered. The detection stage only ever considers whole sentences, so an inline span can never become a candidate.

entries.raw_transcript: Das Meeting ist um drei. 会議は三時です。

expected_detection.text: Das Meeting ist um drei. 会議は三時です。

entries.expected_post_correction: Das Meeting ist um drei. 会議は三時です。
entries.notes: A script switch on its own is only ever observed. Without an independent corroborating signal the passage stays in the transcript, because a language switch is never by itself evidence of a hallucination.

entries.raw_transcript: Das Meeting ist um drei. 会議は三時です。
entries.expected_post_correction: Das Meeting ist um drei.
entries.notes: Same input as the flagged case, but the confidence gate independently rejected the covering segment. Only then may the passage be removed.

entries.raw_transcript: Um die zwei anderen Sachen kümmern wir uns später.

expected_detection.text: Um die zwei anderen Sachen kümmern wir uns später.

entries.expected_post_correction: Um die zwei anderen Sachen kümmern wir uns später.
entries.notes: German 'um' is a preposition, but it is also listed among the English filler interjections the cleanup prompt strips. It appeared 4 times as a preposition in a 75-entry live history sample. The deterministic detection stage must pass the sentence through untouched, and the cleanup instruction must state that a filler is only stripped when it stands alone as an interjection.

profile.prompt:
feature names
bug IDs
release scope
API names
platform constraints
service names
migration steps
infra constraints

entries.raw_transcript: der release scope für die migration steps ist noch nicht klar
entries.expected_post_correction: Der Release Scope für die Migration Steps ist noch nicht klar.
entries.notes: Synthetic eight-line topic profile, not a copy of any shipped seed -- an earlier version of this entry claimed to mirror the curated Product-and-engineering profile, and that claim outlived the seed by two months (ADR 0032). Before ADR 0021 these eight lines reached Cleanup as two (the transcription hint filter dropped every multi-word lowercase line), Agent as all eight raw and unbounded, and Prompt Enhance as all eight raw. The parity assertion below is the guard: one width in every mode. Multi-word lowercase lines are deliberate here -- they are the shape this field is for, and the shape a recognizer-oriented filter would reject.

profile.prompt:
platform constraints
service names
release scope

entries.raw_transcript: wir muessen den service auf Kubernetes umstellen
entries.expected_post_correction: wir muessen den service auf Kubernetes umstellen
entries.notes: A term is granular profile context for every LLM stage (ADR 0033), and Prompt Enhance was the mode that had no channel for one at all -- its config carried no vocabulary field, so a profile's own names could come back respelled from the one mode whose output travels straight into another tool. Asserted across all four modes rather than per mode, because a difference between modes is exactly the class a per-mode test cannot see.

entries.raw_transcript: wir müssen den incident review noch vor dem release freeze machen

contains: never derive or add content from it

entries.expected_post_correction: Wir müssen den Incident Review noch vor dem Release Freeze machen.
entries.notes: Workspace context reaches every mode now, not just prompt enhance. It is a new input into the cleanup prompt and therefore a new hallucination surface, so it must arrive as exactly one bounded line that forbids deriving content from it.

profile.prompt:
platform constraints
service names
release scope

entries.raw_transcript: wir muessen den service auf cuber netties umstellen

expected_vocabulary_repair.text: wir muessen den service auf Kubernetes umstellen

entries.expected_post_correction: wir muessen den service auf Kubernetes umstellen
entries.notes: The case Replacements structurally cannot cover: the recognizer split one term into two tokens and no left-hand side could have been written in advance.

profile.prompt:
platform constraints
service names
release scope

entries.raw_transcript: das steht schon auf der status page

expected_vocabulary_repair.text: das steht schon auf der Statuspage

entries.expected_post_correction: das steht schon auf der Statuspage
entries.notes: No edit distance involved -- normalization alone joins the tokens and fixes the casing. The cheapest and most common repair.

profile.prompt:
platform constraints
service names
release scope

entries.raw_transcript: meine Kollegin Tori kommt spaeter dazu

expected_vocabulary_repair.text: meine Kollegin Tori kommt spaeter dazu

entries.expected_post_correction: meine Kollegin Tori kommt spaeter dazu
entries.notes: Tauri is five characters and Tori is an ordinary name. No threshold separates them, so repair must decline and leave the term to the LLM stages, which can read the sentence. This is the entry that guards against destroying a word the user meant.

profile.prompt:
platform constraints
service names
release scope

entries.raw_transcript: die Umstellung war vollstaendig und lief sauber durch

expected_vocabulary_repair.text: die Umstellung war vollstaendig und lief sauber durch

entries.expected_post_correction: die Umstellung war vollstaendig und lief sauber durch
entries.notes: Long terms present, nothing phonetically close in the transcript. Repair must leave ordinary prose untouched rather than find the nearest term.

profile.prompt:
platform constraints
service names
release scope

entries.raw_transcript: Kubernetes laeuft, cuber netties nicht
entries.expected_post_correction: Kubernetes laeuft, Kubernetes nicht
entries.notes: A window containing a correct occurrence plus the following word stays inside the distance budget while deleting that word. The correct span is protected, so only the mangled one is rewritten and the trailing token survives.

profile.prompt:
platform constraints
service names
release scope

entries.raw_transcript: wir muessen den service auf cuber netties umstellen
entries.expected_post_correction: wir muessen den service auf Kubernetes umstellen
entries.notes: The find the whole feature rests on. The profile carries no vocabulary at all, which is the state every real profile is in, and the correction has just proved three things at once: the recognizer cannot spell this word, it belongs to this person, and the sentence identified it. Nobody could have typed it into a form beforehand.

profile.prompt:
platform constraints
service names
release scope

entries.raw_transcript: wir bauen das mit Tori und React
entries.expected_post_correction: wir bauen das mit Tauri und React
entries.notes: Tauri is five characters and sits below the deterministic repair floor, so once the transcript exists it cannot be recovered. That makes the recognizer slot its only chance and makes it exactly the term that has to be learnable -- the candidate floor therefore sits below the repair floor rather than on it (ADR 0035).

profile.prompt:
platform constraints
service names
release scope

entries.raw_transcript: ich denke wir shippen das uebermorgen
entries.expected_post_correction: ich glaube wir shippen das uebermorgen
entries.notes: The correction swapped one ordinary verb for another. Nothing about the recognizer failed, and learning 'glaube' would put a common word into the term list, where it would reach every LLM prompt and compete for a recognizer slot. The distance between the two words is what declines it.

profile.prompt:
platform constraints
service names
release scope

entries.raw_transcript: also aehm wir shippen das uebermorgen
entries.expected_post_correction: wir shippen das uebermorgen
entries.notes: Cleanup removes fillers by design. A deletion has no replacement word, so there is nothing that could be a term -- but a diff that only looked for changed spans would happily pair the removed filler with the next word.

profile.prompt:
platform constraints
service names
release scope

entries.raw_transcript: wir shippen das uebermorgen und zwar ganz sicher auf jeden Fall
entries.expected_post_correction: wir shippen das uebermorgen ganz sicher
entries.notes: Several words in, fewer words out. This is the shape a rewrite has, and the multi-token replacement is what rules it out: a mangled name arrives as one word after correction, never as a shorter phrase.

profile.prompt:
platform constraints
service names
release scope

entries.raw_transcript: wir shippen das uebermorgen
entries.expected_post_correction: Wir shippen das uebermorgen
entries.notes: The correction capitalized the first word, which it does to every dictation. Folded down to the same token, a case-only change on a single token carries no information about whether the recognizer knew the word.

profile.prompt:
platform constraints
service names
release scope

entries.raw_transcript: Bei c a u d e code oder codex Passt ja alles
entries.biased_correction: Bei CAUDE-Code oder Codex passt ja alles
entries.expected_post_correction: Bei c a u d e-Code oder Codex passt ja alles
entries.notes: Ground truth: the speaker said 'Claude Code'. The recognizer wrote the name out letter by letter and got the letters wrong; the correction then fused them into 'CAUDE-Code'. The wrong letters are not the defect -- the transcript was already broken. The defect is that visible damage became invisible damage: spaced letters are repaired on sight, a capitalized hyphenated token has the shape of a real product name and ships. The profile is deliberately empty, because a dictionary entry would only help someone who has already been bitten (ADR 0036).

profile.prompt:
platform constraints
service names
release scope

entries.raw_transcript: das ist der text des lieds und der zweite switch
entries.biased_correction: Das ist der Text des Lieder und der zweite switcht.
entries.expected_post_correction: Das ist der Text des Lieder und der zweite switcht.
entries.notes: The precision half. 'Lieds' -> 'Lieder' and 'switch' -> 'switcht' are correct German morphology and were the two cases that made a naive 'word not in the raw transcript' metric useless. A guardrail that reverts them costs more than the defect it prevents, so the corpus pins the pass-through as hard as it pins the revert.
